lines_of_business: UnitedHealthcare Community Plan (Medicaid/community plans), excluding ID, IN, KS, KY, NE, NJ, NM, NC, OH, PA, TN which have state-specific policies
sections_in_order: Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews
criteria_location: There are no criteria in the document. Coverage Rationale (p.1) says 'For medical necessity clinical coverage criteria, refer to the InterQual CP: Procedures' for eight named subsets; the only text rule is a list of unproven articular-cartilage products. Definitions of 'Disabling Pain', 'Functional Disability' and 'Radiographic Findings of Osteoarthritis' are present but not attached to any criterion in this document (they presumably support InterQual use or other CS policies).
procedures_covered: Arthroscopy or arthroscopically assisted knee surgery (adult and pediatric)

logic.top_level: other (delegation to InterQual plus a flat exclusion list)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: One list of unproven products (minced cartilage, CMI, Chondrofix, Cartiform/ProChondrix, synthetic polymers, xenograft).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Surgery of the knee is proven and medically necessary in certain circumstances.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: No circumstances given; all content is in a licensed external product.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: UHC will accept three or more moderate to severe radiographic findings to be sufficient to support the diagnosis of severe osteoarthritis.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Defines severe OA but nothing here says what to do with that diagnosis.

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Applicable Codes table (about 50 CPT and 3 HCPCS) is for reference only, includes arthroplasty codes, and is not mapped to anything.
codes.non_covered_code_lists: No code-level split; 0737T, G0428, J7330, S2112 appear in the list while the unproven list is by product.

external_dependencies.quote: refer to the InterQual® CP: Procedures: Arthroscopy or Arthroscopically Assisted Surgery, Knee

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Arthritis Index (WOMAC) pain domain of > 40
Fissuring to the level of subchondral bone in an area with a diameter of more than 1.5 cm

vague_terms.quote: proven and medically necessary in certain circumstances

vague_terms.problem: Defined by WOMAC but no criterion in the document uses them; a chart rarely holds a WOMAC score.

extraction_hazards: Whole 'Click here to view the InterQual criteria' link: criteria not in the PDF
Clinical Evidence (4 pages) reads like criteria but is rationale
Code table broken across pages with repeated header
Definitions ordered alphabetically, mixing product definitions with clinical thresholds
interesting_structures: Pure delegation to a licensed third-party criteria set
Definitions section that contains numeric thresholds with no consumer

fit_to_tree.why: The actual criteria are in InterQual; the PDF supports only an exclusion list and orphaned definitions, so a checker cannot build a tree from this document.
